name: hcportal_markEventChatRead
description: Records that the calling user has read all current messages in an event chat: upserts HC.EventMessageBadgeCounts (EventId, UserId, Removed = 0) with the current non-removed message count, timestamp and latest message id, then returns the FCM tokens of the user's other devices so the API shim can fan out a silent read_sync push that zeroes the badge without a notification. Device-bound portal auth via HC6.ValidatePortalAuth (@publicEventId is in the token param string); service accounts (callerType != 0) are refused. No check that the caller may see the run's chat.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Calling device — used for auth and excluded from the FCM fan-out rowset

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived device token for this SP name

parameters.name: publicEventId
parameters.description: Public GUID of the event whose chat the user just read

rowsets.name: ErrorEnvelope
rowsets.description: Returned instead of the data rowsets on auth failure, service-account caller, NULL @publicEventId, 'Event not found', or from the CATCH block (ERROR_MESSAGE()).

rowsets.name: ReadResult
rowsets.description: Single row confirming the sequence count written.

columns.name: LastSequenceCount
columns.description: The total non-removed message count for this event at the time of the read — written to HC.EventMessageBadgeCounts.LastSequenceCount

rowsets.name: FcmFanoutTargets
rowsets.description: FCM tokens of the calling user's other devices (not the current device). The API shim sends a silent read_sync push to each so their badge counts are zeroed. Zero rows when the user has only one device.

columns.name: FcmToken
columns.description: FCM registration token for one of the user's other devices

sideEffects: MERGE HC.EventMessageBadgeCounts for (EventId, UserId, Removed = 0): UPDATE LastSequenceCount, LastReadAt, LastReadMessageId, updatedAt, or INSERT a new row (inside a transaction)
The API shim sends a silent read_sync push to every token in rowset 1

codeSmells.issue: MERGE without HOLDLOCK on a table with no unique key
codeSmells.detail: Lines 100-113: MERGE runs without WITH (HOLDLOCK) and HC.EventMessageBadgeCounts has no unique constraint on (EventId, UserId). Two concurrent reads (portal + app, or a double tap) can both take the NOT MATCHED branch and insert duplicate badge rows.

codeSmells.issue: CATCH block does not log to HC.ErrorLog
codeSmells.detail: Lines 135-138: CATCH returns the envelope without an HC.ErrorLog row.
Lines 86-93 count messages and pick the latest id before BEGIN TRANSACTION; a message arriving between the two SELECTs can make LastSequenceCount and LastReadMessageId disagree by one.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove or rename the LastSequenceCount column — Flutter reads it to confirm the write succeeded
Never remove the FcmToken column from rowset 1 — the API shim depends on it for fan-out
Never change the exclusion logic for the current device — it must not receive its own read_sync push
